_: The mobile surfaces the design-language sweeps touched, shot on one iOS
Simulator so desktop and mobile are judged from the same change.
The Archive tab is the one that mattered: its sub-tabs and inner tabs were
two local pill classes, and the sub-tab used a SOLID accent fill for mere
selection, which is the primary-button treatment. Both are HollowChip now.
Shot on the unswept commit first, then again with the sweep applied, so the
pair can be stacked. One peer is enough: nothing here is peer-to-peer.
run (on the Mac mini): pwsh scripts/fleet.ps1 -Scenario design_sweep_mobile -Peers a
